_about: The 2.5D side-view test (v4/side-view-test, scripts/side_mode.gd). Camera: beside the lane, long lens, eased. Lane: the strip the protagonist walks; he may step `depth` metres towards or away from the camera, and is pulled back softly. Fight: the heavy feel — hit-stop, shake, stagger.

camera._about: Square to the lane: `elevation` is the angle in degrees the lens looks down from, `distance` how far out it stands. No player rotation.

lane._about: depth: how far he may stand off the lane line, towards or away from the lens. foe_depth: the same for a bandit, tighter so the fight stays flat to the lens. pull: how hard they are eased back to it. edge: how far before the ends of the strip he is stopped.

fight._about: Grounded and heavy. hit_stop: seconds the world freezes on a landed hit; knock_*: how far a blow throws a bandit ALONG the lane (the only direction a side view can show); kill_slowmo: the lean-back on the blow that ends the fight.
